result:
The fix is commit `e7052745` ("TRUNK-6646: Env-var key normalization drops create_database_* / create_user_* credentials in scripted setup", PR #6145, by jwnasambu). It changed `InitializationFilter` in `openmrs-core`.

**Cause:** every environment variable went through `normalizeEnvVariableKey`, which turned `_` into `.` unless the key was in `NON_NORMALIZED_KEYS`. `CREATE_DATABASE_USERNAME` and `CREATE_DATABASE_PASSWORD` were not in that set, so they became `create.database.username` and `create.database.password`. The wizard then read `create_database_username` and got nothing, so it fell back to root with no password.

**Fix:**
- The whitelist now includes the create-database and create-user keys, plus `CONNECTION_DRIVER_CLASS`, `IMPORT_TEST_DATA`, the `REMOTE_*` keys and `ADMIN_PASSWORD_LOCKED` (`openmrs-core/web/src/main/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilter.java:198-202`).
- `normalizeEnvVariableKey` keeps the underscore form for whitelisted keys and still converts the rest to dots (`InitializationFilter.java:1948-1953`).
- The normalized keys are applied to the script properties (`InitializationFilter.java:340-343`). The create-database and create-user values are read from those keys (`InitializationFilter.java:370-385`).
- Related changes in the same commit: the driver class also accepts `connection_driver_class` (`InitializationFilter.java:358-359`). `import_test_data` (or `add_demo_data`), `remote_*` and `admin_password_locked` are read from the resolved properties (`InitializationFilter.java:399-419`). `IMPORT_TEST_DATA` adds the import and module tasks (`InitializationFilter.java:963-966`).
- New tests cover the key normalization (`openmrs-core/web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilterNormalizationTest.java`) and the env-var-to-wizard mapping (`openmrs-core/web/src/test/java/org/openmrs/web/filter/initialization/InitializationFilterTest.java`, the two new tests around lines 163-241).

Line numbers come from the current `HEAD` of `openmrs-core`, read through Falkon. I did not check out the repo or run the tests.
